# Google
> Google provides web search, cloud services, developer platforms, productivity tools, and AI products.

This index highlights major Google properties with emphasis on developer documentation, APIs, product help, research, and official technical resources.

## Search and Core Products
- [Google Search](https://www.google.com/): Google's main web search interface.
- [Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps): Mapping, navigation, places, and local discovery service.
- [Google Images](https://images.google.com/): Image search across the web.
- [Google News](https://news.google.com/): Aggregated news and topic discovery platform.
- [Google Translate](https://translate.google.com/): Machine translation for text, websites, and documents.
- [Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/): Cloud file storage, sharing, and collaboration service.
- [Gmail](https://mail.google.com/): Web-based email service from Google.
- [Google Calendar](https://calendar.google.com/): Scheduling and calendar management application.

## Google Account and Workspace Help
- [Google Account Help](https://support.google.com/accounts): Official help for account settings, sign-in, and security.
- [Google Workspace Learning Center](https://support.google.com/a/users): End-user help for Gmail, Drive, Docs, and Meet.
- [Google Admin Help](https://support.google.com/a/): Administrator documentation for managing Google Workspace.
- [Google Drive Help](https://support.google.com/drive): Official help for Drive storage, sync, and sharing.
- [Gmail Help](https://support.google.com/mail): Official help for Gmail setup, settings, and troubleshooting.
- [Google Docs Editors Help](https://support.google.com/docs): Help for Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, and related editors.
- [Google Meet Help](https://support.google.com/meet): Official help for meetings, calls, and conferencing features.

## Google Cloud Documentation
- [Google Cloud Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/docs): Central documentation hub for Google Cloud products and services.
- [Google Cloud Products](https://cloud.google.com/products): Product directory for infrastructure, data, AI, and security services.
- [Google Cloud Architecture Center](https://cloud.google.com/architecture): Reference architectures, design patterns, and implementation guidance.
- [Google Cloud API Reference](https://cloud.google.com/apis/docs/overview): Overview of Google Cloud APIs and usage patterns.
- [Google Cloud Release Notes](https://cloud.google.com/release-notes): Product release updates across Google Cloud services.
- [Google Cloud Training](https://cloud.google.com/learn): Learning resources, tutorials, and training paths.
- [Google Cloud Support](https://cloud.google.com/support): Support plans, troubleshooting resources, and contact options.

## Google Cloud APIs and SDKs
- [Google Cloud Client Libraries](https://cloud.google.com/apis/docs/client-libraries-explained): Overview of client libraries for Google Cloud APIs.
- [Cloud SDK Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/sdk/docs): Installation and usage docs for the Google Cloud CLI.
- [Google Cloud REST APIs](https://cloud.google.com/apis/docs/overview): REST API concepts and access guidance.
- [Google Cloud Code](https://cloud.google.com/code/docs): IDE tooling for developing and deploying to Google Cloud.
- [Google Cloud Marketplace](https://cloud.google.com/marketplace/docs): Documentation for solutions and integrations in Marketplace.
- [IAM Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/iam/docs): Identity and access management concepts, roles, and policies.
- [Billing Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/billing/docs): Billing setup, budgets, exports, and account management.

## Google Developers
- [Google for Developers](https://developers.google.com/): Central hub for Google developer products, docs, and tools.
- [Developer Documentation](https://developers.google.com/documentation): Entry point to Google developer documentation and references.
- [Google Developer Program](https://developers.google.com/program): Membership program for Google developers.
- [Google Developer Blog](https://developers.googleblog.com/): Official announcements and technical updates for developers.
- [Google Open Source](https://opensource.google/): Open-source projects, programs, and community initiatives.
- [Google Issue Tracker](https://issuetracker.google.com/): Public issue tracking for selected Google developer products.
- [Google Developers YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@GoogleDevelopers): Video tutorials, talks, and product updates for developers.

## Android Development
- [Android Developers](https://developer.android.com/): Official Android app development documentation and tools.
- [Android API Reference](https://developer.android.com/reference): Reference documentation for Android platform APIs.
- [Android Guides](https://developer.android.com/guide): Core guides for app components, UI, and platform behavior.
- [Android Studio](https://developer.android.com/studio): Official IDE downloads, setup, and feature documentation.
- [Jetpack](https://developer.android.com/jetpack): Libraries and guidance for modern Android development.
- [Android Training](https://developer.android.com/courses): Courses and learning resources for Android developers.
- [Android NDK](https://developer.android.com/ndk): Native development kit documentation for C and C++ apps.
- [Material Design for Android](https://developer.android.com/design): Design guidance for Android user experiences.

## Web, Chrome, and Web Platform
- [Chrome for Developers](https://developer.chrome.com/): Documentation for Chrome, web APIs, and browser tooling.
- [Chrome Extensions](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/): Build, test, and publish Chrome extensions.
- [Lighthouse](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/overview): Auditing guidance for performance, accessibility, and SEO.
- [Chrome DevTools](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/): Documentation for debugging and profiling web applications.
- [Web.dev](https://web.dev/): Best practices and guidance for modern web development.
- [Workbox](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/workbox/): Libraries and docs for service workers and offline support.
- [Chromium](https://www.chromium.org/): Open-source project resources for the Chromium browser.

## AI and Machine Learning
- [Google AI](https://ai.google/): Official Google AI research, products, and educational resources.
- [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/): Browser-based environment for building with Google's AI models.
- [Gemini API Documentation](https://ai.google.dev/): Documentation for Google's Gemini API and AI developer tools.
- [Google DeepMind](https://deepmind.google/): Research and product work in advanced AI systems.
- [Google Research](https://research.google/): Publications, projects, and teams across Google research areas.
- [TensorFlow](https://www.tensorflow.org/): Open-source machine learning framework documentation and tutorials.
- [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/): Data science platform with notebooks, datasets, and competitions.
- [Responsible AI](https://ai.google/responsibility/): Principles and resources for responsible AI development.

## Maps, Ads, and Analytics
- [Google Maps Platform](https://developers.google.com/maps): APIs and SDKs for maps, routes, and places.
- [Maps Platform Documentation](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation): Product docs for Maps, Routes, and Places APIs.
- [Google Ads API](https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api): API documentation for managing Google Ads campaigns.
- [Google Ads Help](https://support.google.com/google-ads): Official help for Google Ads accounts and features.
- [Google Analytics Help](https://support.google.com/analytics): Official help for Google Analytics setup and reporting.
- [Google Analytics Developers](https://developers.google.com/analytics): Developer docs for Analytics APIs and integrations.
- [Tag Manager Help](https://support.google.com/tagmanager): Official help for Google Tag Manager configuration and usage.

## YouTube and Media Platforms
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/): Video hosting, streaming, and creator platform owned by Google.
- [YouTube Help](https://support.google.com/youtube): Official help for viewers, creators, and channel management.
- [YouTube for Developers](https://developers.google.com/youtube): APIs and developer tools for YouTube integrations.
- [YouTube Data API](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3): Reference and guides for the YouTube Data API.
- [YouTube Creator Academy](https://creatoracademy.youtube.com/): Educational resources for building and managing YouTube channels.

## Research, Security, and Policy
- [Google Security Blog](https://security.googleblog.com/): Official updates on security research, threats, and defenses.
- [Google Safety Center](https://safety.google/): Information on privacy, security, and online safety practices.
- [Google Privacy Center](https://policies.google.com/privacy): Privacy policy and related information for Google services.
- [Google Terms of Service](https://policies.google.com/terms): Terms governing use of Google products and services.
- [Project Zero](https://googleprojectzero.blogspot.com/): Security research blog focused on vulnerability discovery and disclosure.
- [Google Research Publications](https://research.google/pubs/): Searchable index of Google research papers and publications.
- [Google Transparency Report](https://transparencyreport.google.com/): Data and reporting on traffic, safety, and government requests.
